1_executive_summary: P-04 — NEP enzyme immobilized on catheter wall clears Aβ42 via mass-transport-limited c. A computationally specified P-04 concept plus a preregistered decisive experiment — not a validated technology. Current evidence: T1. Transfer posture: DECISIVE_EXPERIMENT_REQUIRED. Recommended transaction: CO_DEVELOPMENT (wet-lab dependent). Validation cost: $20-50K wet lab.

8_strategic_buyer_fit.ideal_buyer: Pharma company with Alzheimer's program + device division (e.g., Eli Lilly, Roche)
8_strategic_buyer_fit.strategic_reason: Catheter-based Aβ clearance is a device-drug combination. No current catheter-based clearance option exists. Could complement monoclonal antibody programs.
8_strategic_buyer_fit.capabilities_required: Drug-device combination regulatory experience, CNS drug development, catheter access to CSF
8_strategic_buyer_fit.why_this_buyer_would_care: Adjacent to existing Alzheimer's programs. Device-drug combination is a differentiating IP strategy.

10_why_now: Alzheimer's market is massive ($50-200K/patient/year). Amyloid clearance via catheter is a first-in-class concept. Monoclonal antibodies have limited CNS penetration — device-drug combination addresses this. Wet-lab validation is the bottleneck.
